name: zweapon_on_weapons_section_pre_load
description: zWeapon::OnWeaponsSectionPreLoad writes the weapon damage-feedback hit count as the Weapons/WeaponData ZAR blob.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this callback; tier S verification is deferred to the zWeapon/OptCatalog source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b1140 validates ECX as zZbdSectionCallbackCtx*, ignored EDX userdata, copying g_OptCatalog_DamageFeedbackHitCount to a 4-byte stack payload, section token WeaponData, and returning zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob status.
The native smoke verifies the written Weapons/WeaponData record name, payload size, payload value, and write success through the real zUtil_ZAR::WriteSectionBlob path.
